name: emergent-technologies
description: Emergent Technologies public website, registration system, and admin portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev --name init --skip-seed && npm run db:seed
